data_quality_checklist.name: Missing Events
data_quality_checklist.description: Verify that all funnel stages fire tracking payloads without dropping events.

data_quality_checklist.name: Duplicate Events
data_quality_checklist.description: Ensure deduplication IDs prevent double-counting on page refresh or multi-click.

data_quality_checklist.name: Bot & Internal Traffic Filter
data_quality_checklist.description: Exclude automated scrapers, CI test runs, and internal team IP addresses.

data_quality_checklist.name: Attribution Window Consistency
data_quality_checklist.description: Standardize lookback windows (e.g. 7-day click, 0-day view) across all channels.

data_quality_checklist.name: Timezone Alignment
data_quality_checklist.description: Normalize all reporting timestamps to UTC to prevent date-boundary distortion.

data_quality_checklist.name: Currency Standardization
data_quality_checklist.description: Normalize all spend logs to USD at daily exchange rates.

data_quality_checklist.name: Event Definition Drift
data_quality_checklist.description: Maintain immutable event schemas to prevent breaking upstream reporting changes.

data_quality_checklist.name: Denominator Verification
data_quality_checklist.description: Audit formulas to ensure CTR = clicks/impressions and CVR = conversions/visitors.

data_quality_checklist.name: Identity Resolution Consistency
data_quality_checklist.description: Ensure anonymous session IDs do not fragment across subdomains.

data_quality_checklist.name: Late-Arriving Conversion Lag
data_quality_checklist.description: Apply maturity adjustments for conversions that occur days after initial impression.

data_quality_checklist.name: Sample Ratio Mismatch (SRM)
data_quality_checklist.description: Perform chi-square tests on A/B traffic splits to detect allocation bias.

data_quality_checklist.name: Tracking Outage Alerting
data_quality_checklist.description: Set automated alert triggers if event ingestion drops by >50% hour-over-hour.

data_reliability_gate: Data reliability must be validated as PASS before calculating experiment results or triggering budget adjustments.
